name: Jerk chicken thighs
steps: Blend the spring onion, garlic, thyme, allspice, soy sauce, lime juice and oil into a rough marinade.
Coat the chicken thighs and leave to sit for at least 20 minutes.
Heat a griddle or heavy pan until very hot.
Sear the thighs for 5 to 6 minutes each side until charred and cooked through.
Spoon over any remaining marinade for the last minute.
Rest for a couple of minutes, then serve.
